title: Engine resource loader: load word lists from registry
description: Add ResourceStore to Rust engine. Loads resources declared in game definitions. For word_list type: loads a newline-delimited text file into a HashSet<String>. Lookup via word_valid(resource_name, word) -> bool. Resource files stored in registry/dictionaries/. ResourceStore attached to GameSession. Defensive: missing resource file is an error at load time, not at query time.
close_reason: ResourceStore with word_list loading, word_valid(), defensive size/count limits. All tests pass.
